blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Transportation (DOTr) will offer free rides along select routes in Metro Manila for commuters affected by the transport strike on November 23-24. The DOTr said the free rides would be available on Monday and Tuesday, from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. Transport group Manibela will hold the strike to protest the reported change in leadership at the Land Transportation Office (LTO). Manibela has repeatedly expressed its support for LTO Chairperson Markus Lacanilao. Manibela also said it would stage a protest in front of the LTO Central Office in Quezon City on Monday at 9 a.m. […]...
